about_company.about_short: Telecom equipment maker: OFC, fiber, defence, EPC.
about_company.business_intro: HFCL makes optical fibre and cable, data-centre connectivity products, Wi-Fi, 5G and networking equipment, and defence electronics, and runs telecom network projects (turnkey EPC and O&M) that it is deliberately scaling back. Its Q2 FY27 deck puts products at about 91% of revenue, exports at about 63% and private-sector customers at 92%. Revenue comes mainly from product sales to telecom operators, hyperscalers and enterprises in India and abroad, and on the project side from contract execution.
about_company.about_long: HFCL Limited makes optical fibre and optical fibre cable, passive and data-centre connectivity products, telecom and networking equipment (Wi-Fi, 5G FWA CPE, routers, switches) and defence products (fuzes, radars, thermal sights, hand grenades, tactical cables), and executes telecom network projects (EPC, system integration and O&M). It reports four segments: Telecom Products (87.8% of H1 FY27 consolidated revenue), Turnkey Contracts and Services (9.3%), Defence Product & Services (1.8%) and Others (1.1%). Its Q2 FY27 deck puts products at about 91% of revenue, exports at about 63% and private-sector customers at 92%; customers include global hyperscalers and telecom operators. A 600 MT-a-year preform plant (₹1,250 Cr, targeted by October 2028, being set up in Madhya Pradesh) and fibre and cable expansions due by July 2028 are planned, not operating. A pending acquisition of an aerospace business into subsidiary HFCL Advance Systems (MoU signed 25 March 2026, completion expected in the October-December 2026 quarter) is not yet in the reported numbers. A board Strategic Restructuring Committee (formed 30 April 2026, Ernst & Young as adviser) is evaluating strategic options across the business verticals; no business, form or timeline has been named.

business_facts.title: Four reported segments; Telecom Products was 88% of H1 FY27 revenue
business_facts.text: HFCL reports four segments. In H1 FY27, of consolidated revenue of ₹4,456.77 Cr, Telecom Products was ₹3,911.51 Cr (87.8%), Turnkey Contracts and Services ₹416.39 Cr (9.3%), Defence Product & Services ₹78.68 Cr (1.8%) and Others ₹50.19 Cr (1.1%). Telecom Products bundles two of the deck's four engines, optical fibre, cable and connectivity, and telecom and networking equipment; no consolidated split between them is published. The Q2 FY27 deck puts products at about 91% of revenue without naming the period. The FY26 annual report's standalone product table gave optical fibre cables 46.17% of turnover and telecom products/equipment 10.44%.

business_facts.title: Largest customer was 13% of FY26 revenue
business_facts.text: One customer brought in ₹646.32 Cr in FY26, 13.1% of consolidated revenue of ₹4,949.27 Cr, and was the only customer above 10%. In FY25 three customers were each above 10% and together brought in ₹1,899.37 Cr, 46.7% of revenue of ₹4,064.52 Cr. Private-sector customers were 92% of revenue in the Q2 FY27 deck (period not named), which describes a shift from government to private customers.

business_facts.title: Exports jumped to 41% of revenue in FY26
business_facts.text: Revenue from customers outside India was ₹2,047.18 Cr in FY26, 41.4% of consolidated revenue, against ₹496.97 Cr (12.2%) in FY25, ₹500.64 Cr (11.2%) in FY24 and ₹817.49 Cr (17.2%) in FY23. The Q2 FY27 deck puts exports at about 63% of revenue (period not named), and 57% of the ₹28,911 Cr order book is export.

business_facts.title: Fibre and cable capacity today vs planned
business_facts.text: Operating capacity is 28 mn fkm a year of optical fibre and 39 mn fkm a year of optical fibre cable. Both are being expanded, to about 43.1 mn fkm (fibre) and 62 mn fkm (cable) by July 2028; that added capacity is planned, not yet operating. HFCL's plants are in Hyderabad, Goa, Chennai (through subsidiary HTL Limited) and Hosur (defence equipment).

business_facts.title: Order book ₹28,911 Cr at Q2 FY27
business_facts.text: The order book was ₹28,911 Cr at Q2 FY27, against ₹26,665 Cr at Q1 FY27 and ₹21,206 Cr at end FY26; 57% of it is export and 64% comes from OFC and data-centre interconnect. At end FY26 it split into OF/OFC and connectivity ₹13,483 Cr (including ₹12,248 Cr export), telecom equipment ₹804 Cr, EPC and system integration ₹6,620 Cr and defence about ₹300 Cr, excluding ₹1,930 Cr held by the aerospace business HFCL proposes to acquire.

business_facts.title: Preform plant planned: 600 MT a year by October 2028
business_facts.text: HFCL plans a 600 MT-a-year preform plant with ₹1,250 Cr of capex, targeted by October 2028, and says it is now establishing the facility in Madhya Pradesh. It sits within about ₹1,800 Cr of planned investment across optical fibre, cable and preform. In July 2026 the plan was 300 MT a year for ₹580 Cr by July 2029. The plant is planned, not operating.

business_facts.title: Aerospace business acquisition: pending, not closed
business_facts.text: HFCL signed an MoU on 25 March 2026 to acquire an aerospace business into its wholly owned subsidiary HFCL Advance Systems. On 19 October 2026 it said completion is expected during the current quarter (October-December 2026). The Q2 FY27 deck puts that business's export order book at about ₹1,600 Cr (about ₹1,930 Cr in the Q4 FY26 deck) within a total defence order book of about ₹1,850 Cr; the drop is not explained. None of the business is in the reported numbers yet.

business_facts.title: Defence is still small
business_facts.text: Defence Product & Services revenue was ₹76.70 Cr in FY26 (about 1.5% of consolidated revenue of ₹4,949.27 Cr) and ₹78.68 Cr in H1 FY27 (1.8%), with a segment loss of ₹5.05 Cr in FY26 and ₹4.59 Cr in H1 FY27. The company aims for about ₹500 Cr of defence and aerospace revenue in FY27 and says it is on track; that is a target, and it does not say whether it counts the aerospace business being acquired.

what_changed.headline: In H1 FY27 products and exports took a far larger share of revenue, while shrinking turnkey projects slid deeper into loss
what_changed.text: In H1 FY27 Turnkey Contracts and Services was ₹416.39 Cr, 9.3% of consolidated revenue of ₹4,456.77 Cr, against 37.9% of FY26 revenue in the annual report (31.8% after the Q2 FY27 filing regrouped FY26). Its segment loss widened to ₹122.58 Cr in Q2 FY27 on ₹136.07 Cr of revenue; the filing gives no cause. Telecom Products was 87.8% of H1 revenue. Exports were about 63% of revenue in the Q2 FY27 deck against 41.4% for FY26. The EBITDA margin, including other income, was 25.89% in Q2 FY27 against 16.70% for FY26.
